title: «الصلاحية» as a page inside the + sheet

steps.name: permission-page
steps.lead_notes: Reuse the permission menu content from PermissionMenu.tsx as a page inside the sheet; one implementation, two hosts.

gaps.title: «الصلاحية» in the + sheet is not a page inside the sheet
gaps.reference_evidence: Desktop-37 4980-4984 toolsSheet("permission"): the sheet slides (dir fwd, sheetMorph) to «صلاحيات {name}» with the three level rows (checked) and «الهوية والنموذج», back returns to the main page. DESIGN_TREE_37 line 197: «الصلاحية (صفحة داخل الورقة)».
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/conversation/ToolsSheet.tsx:143-154 closes the sheet then programmatically clicks .composer .mode-chip in the next frame (shots/composer/app-plus-permission.png).
gaps.owner_sees: The sheet disappears and a separate popover appears instead of the sheet turning its page.
gaps.fix_plan: Give ToolsBody a second page: open with sheets.open(..., {morph:true}) like ChatMenu.tsx:221 / ListSheets.tsx:316, render the ladder rows (role=menuitemradio, LEVEL_ICON, levelName/levelHint, check), reuse PermissionMenu's setLevel/mandate/downgrade logic (export it), add «الهوية والنموذج» -> /app/identity/<agent>, and a back that returns to the main page.
gaps.verifier_note: Risk: PermissionMenu holds the money-safety logic (setLevel, mandate, downgrade confirmation). Export and reuse it; do not copy it. The page must show the same unknown/failed state and the same blocking rules as the popover. A morph sheet is already used by shell/ChatMenu.tsx:221 and shell/lists/ListSheets.tsx:316. Keep the .mode-chip in the composer as the desktop trigger. e2e specs may click the sheet row and then expect the popover, so grep the Playwright specs for tools-sheet permission flows. Also check the sub text for the unknown level.
